# Third-Party Integrations

Integrations with popular third-party libraries and formats:

- {doc}`../ibis` (`nominal.ibis`): an Ibis backend for querying the Nominal SQL API.
  Install with `nominal[ibis]`.
- {doc}`matlab` (`nominal.thirdparty.matlab`).
- {doc}`pandas` (`nominal.thirdparty.pandas`), installed by default.
- {doc}`polars` (`nominal.thirdparty.polars`), installed by default.
- {doc}`tdms` (`nominal.tdms`). Install with `nominal[tdms]`.
